# portainer_kubernetes_node_metrics (Data Source)

Reads live resource usage of a single Kubernetes node from metrics-server.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "portainer_kubernetes_node_metrics" "worker" {
  environment_id = 1
  node           = "worker-1"
}

output "worker_cpu" {
  value = data.portainer_kubernetes_node_metrics.worker.cpu
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (Number) Environment (endpoint) identifier of the Kubernetes environment to query.
- `node` (String) Name of the node to read metrics for. Use `portainer_kubernetes_nodes` for every node at once.

### Read-Only

- `cpu` (String) CPU usage of the node as a Kubernetes quantity string.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource.
- `memory` (String) Memory usage of the node as a Kubernetes quantity string.
- `timestamp` (String) When the sample was taken.
- `window` (String) Length of the sampling window, such as `30s`.

## Attributes Reference

Use `portainer_kubernetes_nodes` to get usage for every node at once — it already folds the cluster-wide metrics endpoint in, and tolerates a cluster without metrics-server.
